capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV "82 kWh total" for the Model Y LR AWD 2021-2025, and the Model 3 Panasonic 2170L pack is 82.0 nominal (EV Database 1525, src-evdb-m3-lrawd-2021-pana). Not a Fremont-specific Model Y page. Model 3 sibling batch records the same Panasonic 2170L pack at 82 / 76 (EV Database 1525); Model Y usable 75 per EV Database/ArenaEV. ArenaEV covers 2021-2025; 2020 assumed the same pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database useable 75 kWh (itself an estimate); not Fremont-specific, assumed the same for 2020-2023 NA cars.
Estimated: ArenaEV 82 kWh total / 75 kWh usable for the Model Y LR AWD 2021-2025.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: Panasonic 2170 NCA cells go into Model 3/Y built in California (Fremont). Applied to the 2020-2023 Fremont Long Range / Performance.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists a 400 V architecture (357 V nominal) for the same-generation Long Range AWD.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

Estimated: Listing for the same model family says preconditioning is possible and starts automatically when navigating to a charger. Combined with the Teslabs no-manual-control statement. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV lists 250 kW Supercharger V3 for the Model Y LR AWD 2021-2025; EV Database lists 250 kW for LR AWD and Performance.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport puts the non-Standard Model Y trims at the 11.5 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America); Wikipedia: up to 11.5 kW AC on all variants. EU listings quote 11 kW 3-phase, not used.
Estimated: Wikipedia: all Model Y variants support up to 11.5 kW AC.
